parameters.content:
## Create event promos and countdown reminders

### How it works
For event organizers: read a Google Sheets calendar or upcoming Eventbrite events, then render the most urgent video due for each event. Zvid creates a vertical announcement, seven-day reminder or final call. Completed links return to the sheet; Eventbrite mode remembers completed assets in workflow data. Social posting is not included.

### Setup
1. Use self-hosted n8n. Install **@zvid/n8n-nodes-zvid** from **Settings → Community nodes** before credentials. A workspace owner/admin may need to install it.
2. Create a **Zvid API** credential with [your API key](https://app.zvid.io/api-keys) and Base URL **https://api.zvid.io**. Select it on every Zvid node.
3. Connect both Google Sheets nodes to the same spreadsheet and tab. Use the headers in section 2. Add a future **EventName** and **DateISO** (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm); leave the four result columns empty.
4. In **Config**, set branding and **timezoneOffsetHours**. Keep **todayOverride** empty for real dates, or use it to rehearse reminder days. Past events are skipped.
5. **dryRun=false** renders and spends credits, about 14 per video. The default limit is one video per run. Optional **dryRun=true** requires a Zvid node exposing **Project → Create**; released v0.1.8 does not support that branch.
6. For **source=eventbrite**, set **eventbriteOrgId** and select a Bearer Auth credential on **Fetch Eventbrite events**. It reads the first 50 live events.
7. Test manually before enabling the daily schedule. Use public licensed images within your render-plan limits; the corrected default background is 1080×1440.

### Customization
Adjust copy, colors, fonts and music in Config. [Full guide](https://github.com/Zvid-io/zvid-n8n/blob/master/workflows/event-countdown-videos.md).

## 1. Set up and check music

Use Config for branding and timing. Test manually before enabling the 8am schedule. The music guard omits an unreachable or oversized track so the video can still render.

## 2. Choose the event due today

Sheet headers: EventName, DateISO, Venue, City, TicketUrl, ImageUrl, Status, PromoUrl, Video7d, Video1d. Leave the last four empty initially. Only future or today’s events qualify; an existing completion marker prevents duplicate promos.

nodes.name: 3. Build, validate and choose the mode

parameters.content:
## 3. Build, validate and choose the mode

Build the due announcement or reminder and check its validation result and quote. The default false branch renders. Optional draft mode requires Project → Create support; released Zvid v0.1.8 supports the default render path only.

## 4. Render and wait for completion

Submit the selected video and poll its job until completion or timeout. If a job times out, check it in Zvid before retrying. A failed render leaves the event’s result cells unchanged.

## 5. Record the completed video

Write the URL to PromoUrl, Video7d or Video1d and set Status after success. Eventbrite mode records completion in workflow data. For repeat sheet tests, clear only the intended sample’s completion cells.

## 6. Watch the finished video

Open Watch video → Binary → data → View. Empty links and draft results skip this step. A preview-download failure leaves the completed link available in Run summary.
